entries.en: long ago; for a long time; of old

entries.zh: 往年；多年前；过去的年月
entries.en: in past years; years ago; in former times
the past days; days ago; formerly
formerly; some time ago; a while back
entries.notes: L 栏「tha tiempo」当为「ha tiempo」（已有相当时日）之误录，M 栏多出 sūn chōng 两音未详，故降为中等。

entries.zh: 早先；前阵子；好一段时间以前
entries.en: a while ago; earlier; for a long stretch of time past
entries.notes: H 栏「惇」疑为「阵」之残坏，据 M「chà chūn（早阵）」与 R 栏定其义为早先；L「entero tiempo」即「一整段时间」。

entries.en: in the very beginning; from the earliest times; at the origin
entries.notes: L「aloprincipio」为「a lo principio」连写；M 栏另存「gī chuy」一读未详，释义据 H「当元初」与 R 栏定。

entries.en: originally; at the outset; in the beginning
at first; originally; from the start
entries.notes: L 栏「antigua menze」为「antiguamente」之残写，释义以 H「起原先」与 R 栏三音次第相合而定。

entries.en: at first; at the beginning; initially

entries.zh: 远古之时；原早（如亚当的时代）
entries.en: in ancient times (as in the time of Adam)
entries.notes: L 栏「2a Adan」疑为「de Adan」误录；H「惇」疑「阵」之残，据 M「guān chà chūn（原早阵）」定为「很早以前」。

entries.en: since ancient times; from of old
in the beginning; at the first; originally
formerly; originally; at first
as of old; as before; unchanged
very early; long before; well in advance
remote antiquity; high antiquity

entries.zh: 长寿；高寿（「寿山」喻长久之年）
entries.en: long life; a ripe old age (lit. 'mount of longevity')
entries.notes: L「edad larga」谓年寿之长；M 栏另附「gūĩ cai」两音未详，R 栏仅存「sū sān」，故降为中等。

entries.en: eyeglasses; spectacles

entries.zh: 孕妇的偏嗜；病中的馋想
entries.en: a pregnant woman's craving; a morbid appetite
entries.notes: H 栏「病口」与 M「pē chūy（病嘴）」相合，指孕中嗜食偏味，然用字残缺可疑，故降为中等。

entries.en: a whim; a sudden craving (for any thing)
entries.notes: H 栏「僻」当通「癖」（嗜好），R 栏「boy」与 H 音不合，释义据 L「antojo」与 H 字义定。

entries.en: an eccentric disposition; idiosyncrasy; a peculiar bent
entries.notes: M 栏夹写「inclination」为编者释义而非对音；H「僻性」通「癖性」，R 栏「boy」音讹，故降为中等。

entries.en: to knot; to tie a knot
entries.notes: L 栏「A Nudas」疑为「añudar（打结）」条目之残写，释义据 H「结」与 L 推定，M 栏「car gīn gua car」多为衬字难复原。
